modes.name: Midnight Clinic
modes.description: Four chapters of supernatural appointments. The clinic opens at midnight.
modes.panelLabel: EXPANSION 3 · SOME THINGS ONLY COME TO THE SURFACE AFTER DARK
modes.blurb: A clandestine after-hours practice for patients whose skin problems are beyond conventional explanation. Ten patient classes, eight materials, four instruments, sixteen appointments and four bosses.
modes.tagline: I have seen some things in this profession. Apparently I have not seen enough. — Dani
modes.completeTitle: The clinic closes for the night
modes.completeText: Every patient seen. The clinic closes whenever the last patient leaves, and the last patient left about six hundred years ago.

modes.name: Midnight Endless
modes.description: A procedurally chosen supernatural appointment every shift, with a rare variant and a boss every fourth patient.

modes.name: Midnight Zen

modes.name: The Ratfather's Referral
modes.description: A hidden referral case. One patient. One very familiar problem.

tutorials.title: Opening the clinic
steps: The clinic is open. Every appointment is a reservoir network: scan it, read it, then extract it.
Conditions matter. Moon, temperature, spectral windows and bioluminescence change how a reservoir drains.
Phase-locked chambers open and close on a readable cycle. Watch the readout before you commit.
Every patient class has its own materials and its own obstruction. Choose the instrument that fits the obstruction, not the biggest number.

tutorials.title: The Silver Loop
steps: The Silver Loop holds a steady alignment band. Release inside it and the grip is clean.
A perfect alignment draws extra material from cohesive, dark or mineral-heavy chambers. It breaks nothing, so bring a second instrument for obstructions.

tutorials.title: Spectral Extractor
steps: The spectral extractor steps its pressure band in three positions.
It can grip a phase-locked chamber while it is out of phase. Other instruments have to wait for the window.

tutorials.title: Cryo Wand
steps: The cryo wand changes the fictional properties of a chamber: it cracks crystalline cores and drains brittle material.
It gives up some flow rate for that authority. Crystalline obstructions no longer stop it.

tutorials.title: Arcane Resonator
steps: The arcane resonator reveals concealed connections as it works and ruptures septa, cores and moving plugs.
It is slower and drains less per release. It is the only instrument that answers a septal network without a second tool.
